violations.why: The higher-priority communicate ISR can preempt the measure ISR between the increment and the read-back. It resets tickCounter, so the measure ISR reads a value it didn't write.
The ISR can write tickCounter between the read and the write of the non-atomic tickCounter++. That update is lost.
The communicate ISR can reset intervalCounter between the read and write of intervalCounter++. The reset is overwritten with a stale value.
The communicate ISR can reset numberOfRecords after the measure ISR used it as the records index. The measure ISR then increments a stale value, so the index and count are inconsistent.
The communicate ISR can write numberOfRecords between the read and write of numberOfRecords++. The reset is lost.
